from fastmcp import Server

server = Server("message-templates")

@server.tool()
def summarize(text: str) -> dict:
    """Fetch a message template that asks to summarize text.
    
    Args:
        text: The text to be summarized
        
    Returns:
        A user message dict with role and content
    """
    return {
        "role": "user",
        "content": f"Please summarize the following text:\n\n{text}"
    }

if __name__ == "__main__":
    server.run()
